summary: The auto inventory plugin loads whatever plugin is named by the plugin key in a YAML inventory config, effectively enabling all installed inventory plugins; remove it from INVENTORY_ENABLED to disable.
questions: Why does my YAML inventory config with plugin: aws_ec2 work without enabling the plugin?
How do I disable automatic loading of inventory plugins?
What does the auto inventory plugin do?

answer_card.title: auto inventory plugin
answer_card.answer_md: With `auto` enabled, any YAML inventory config with a `plugin` key at its root automatically loads and runs that plugin. This effectively enables all installed inventory plugins. To turn this off, remove `auto` from the `INVENTORY_ENABLED` setting.
